summary.headline: No findings detected in the audited sample.

opportunities.title: No schema.org JSON-LD exists on sampled ar.wikipedia.org articles, for the same reason this is not flagged on ja.wikipedia.org or arxiv.org
opportunities.rationale: Consistent with this project's ja.wikipedia.org report: a real, different, and independently maintained machine-readable channel (Wikidata) already serves the purpose on-page schema.org markup would, and is linked from every article. Flagging its absence the same way eff.org's genuine absence-of-any-channel was flagged would be a false positive.
opportunities.mechanism: Not applicable -- recorded to explain a deliberate non-finding, consistent with this project's cross-site calibration discipline.

not_assessed.reason: declared_language is 'ar' (non-English); per this skill's documented exception, English-keyword density classifiers do not apply and were not run. No systematic question-coverage derivation was performed in the time available.
not_assessed.impact: Cannot state a coverage percentage; a scope limit of this run, not a claim about content quality, which reads as substantive (35,219 characters) on direct inspection.

not_assessed.check: Right-to-left-specific text extraction edge cases -- bidirectional control characters, Arabic-Indic vs. Western numeral handling in date/phone regexes (freshness-corroboration-audit)
not_assessed.reason: Not systematically probed. This run confirmed the page fetches and decodes correctly (dir="rtl", lang="ar" both present and correct) and that overall text volume extracts sensibly, but did not specifically stress-test whether numeral or date regexes elsewhere in this project behave correctly against Arabic-Indic digits (Ù -Ù©) if a sampled page used them instead of Western digits.
not_assessed.impact: A genuine, narrower gap than this run had time to close. Worth a follow-up run specifically sampling pages that mix numeral systems.

not_assessed.reason: This run hand-verified one article page, chosen specifically to confirm the non-ASCII URL fix (from the ja.wikipedia.org run) generalizes to a different script family and reading direction, rather than sampling broadly.
not_assessed.impact: The one page sampled delivered full, real text with no JavaScript dependency; a broader sample was not attempted.
